terminal_name: Tlou Energy - Lesedi CBM project (NOT an LNG terminal)
issue: Discovery checked Tlou Energy's Lesedi coal bed methane project (Central District, Botswana) as a possible missing LNG terminal. It is a CBM gas-TO-POWER project (10MW PPA with Botswana Power Corporation, expanding toward 25MW then 100MW+, plus a co-located data center). There is NO LNG liquefaction, storage, or regasification component. Per project scope it is not an LNG terminal and should NOT be added to the LNG tracker.
suggested_action: No action; recorded so a future discovery pass does not re-investigate Tlou/Lesedi as an LNG lead. Source: https://tlouenergy.com/projects/ ; https://www.africa-energy.com/database/tlou-lesedi-coal-bed-methane

terminal_name: Botswana LNG Terminal (Serowe CBM, Botala Energy)
issue: Discovery confirms this is the only LNG terminal in GEM for Botswana and it is correctly covered (no new-terminal gap here). Flagging substantial UPDATE-domain news accumulated since the 2023 proposal that an Update pass should fold in: Botala completed LNG feasibility (Sept 2024) and a Bankable Feasibility Study; secured binding LNG offtake LOIs (SCAW South Africa, 3.5 PJ/a expandable to 4.7 PJ/a) and supply/MOU arrangements (FFS Refiners; NOVO Energy); Minerals Development Company Botswana (government) taking a 15% stake (~P35m / ~$3.6m) plus a 1% royalty; mining licence / regulatory approval to transition to commercial production (Mar 2025); FID targeted 2H 2026; first LNG 2027/28; Phase 1 ~200 t/d, Phase 2 up to ~800 t/d; Phase 2 to add wells + a Galileo mini-LNG unit. Capacity values in GEM (Phase 1 = 0.07 mtpa, Phase 2 = 0.29 mtpa) and ownership/parent fields may warrant re-check against these.
